data.name: VIVA - VRIDIAN Integrated Virtual Architecture
data.detailed_description:
VIVA: VRIDIAN Integrated Virtual Architecture is a global urban exploration platform that turns real cities into living, playable digital worlds. Built by VRIDIAN, an architecture and spatial‑computing firm, VIVA blends physical and digital space to invite human‑centric engagement: explore authentic urban places, discover unique points of view, and connect with the city in a groundbreaking way.

VIVA begins with Pittsburgh — Early Access 2026 Launch Edition and will expand through multiple content updates during Early Access. VIVA is equal parts video game and interactive local interest magazine - a platform that is designed to grow with people—residents, visitors, local businesses, cultural institutions, and city partners—so the experience reflects real places, real insights, and, over time, real interaction and commerce.

Community at the Core

VIVA is developed in the open with the community. We’ll share edition plans, run polls, host playtests, and invite feedback on traversal, districts, accessibility, partner experiences, and future cities. Your ideas influence what gets built next—district by district, city by city. Join our Discord in the sidebar to join the conversation!

What You’ll Do

  • Explore real places — Navigate curated neighborhoods modeled from on-location data, with clear wayfinding and “why this matters” context woven through each space.

  • Move in new ways — Use V.E.E. (VRIDIAN Environment Explorer) to fly, glide, grapple, sail, or dive across rooftops, riverfronts, bridges, and skylines.

  • Learn with purpose — Unlock concise, factual encyclopedia entries revealing architectural, cultural, and civic content represented in real-world context.

  • Connect and co‑create — Help prioritize neighborhoods, experiences, and partner integrations; progressively trial interaction and commerce with local businesses and institutions during EA.

Available at Early Access Launch

  • Free‑to‑Play base platform

  • VIVA Pittsburgh — Early Access Edition (Free DLC)

  • Objective exploration mode focused on learning and discovery

  • V.E.E. traversal modes (launch suite; polish continues during EA)

  • 8–12 curated encyclopedic entries (launch set)

  • 2–3 traversal routes/challenges (launch set)

  • Foundation for monthly editions and regular content updates

Some city layers may stream data in real time; installed modules remain playable offline when available.

Roadmap Highlights (Planned During Early Access)

  • Multiplayer exploration — Shared city sessions, meet‑ups, and collaborative routes to experience neighborhoods together.

  • VR support — Immersive city presence for compatible headsets (initial experimental builds; device support to be announced).

  • Partner experiences & commerce — Progressive roll‑outs with cities, local businesses, and cultural institutions to enable real interaction and shopping in digital twins.

Global and Modular by Design

VIVA’s cities are delivered as optional, lightweight modules so players can explore the places they care about while keeping installation sizes manageable. As the platform grows beyond Pittsburgh, we will collaborate with additional cities, venues, and community partners to bring human‑centered, place‑based interaction to life.

data.short_description: Travel through real cities brought to life. VIVA: VRIDIAN Integrated Virtual Architecture blends true-to-life graphics with rich discovery across an expanding network of living digital cities—starting with Pittsburgh and growing worldwide.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 (6 cores recommended)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible GPU with 6 GB VRAM (8 GB preferred)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Additional Notes: Some city layers may stream from online services; internet connection recommended for the full experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7 / AMD Ryzen 7 (8 cores or better)
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible GPU with 8–12 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Additional Notes: Some city layers may stream from online services; internet connection recommended for the full experience.
